people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: Your watchmen lift up their voice. Together they sing; for they shall see eye to eye when Yahweh returns to Zion.
translations.bsb: Listen! Your watchmen lift up their voices, together they shout for joy. For every eye will see when the LORD returns to Zion.
translations.kjv: Thy watchmen shall lift up the voice; with the voice together shall they sing: for they shall see eye to eye, when the LORD shall bring again Zion.
translations.asv: The voice of thy watchmen! they lift up the voice, together do they sing; for they shall see eye to eye, when Jehovah returneth to Zion.
